title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and [Em]time shall be no [G]more,
[G]When the saved of earth shall gather [Em]over [G]on the other [F#dim]shore,
[F#dim]And the roll is called up yonder, [G]I'll be there.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [D7]When the roll is called up yonder,
[C]When the roll is called up yonder,
[C/G]When the [G]roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]And the roll is called up [C]yonder, I'll [D7]be there.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]Let us talk of all [Em]His wondrous [G]love and care,
[G]And the roll is called up [C]yonder I'll [D7]be there.
